verification.no_stale_dist: only dist consumed is packages/state/dist freshly built by CMD2 (exit 0) at this base for the bytes probe; cloudflare dist absent (CMD3 exit 2) and unused; work sources executed from src via node type-stripping exactly as the green tests do

work.schedule.id: occurrenceId (NOT the key); key looked up via flat scope fields; head resolves through backward replaces link, never id comparison

work.fanout_intent.id: fanout/v1/{enc(sourceOccurrence)}/{enc(handler)}/{cohort}; store PK enforces insert-once per cutoff+cohort; members sorted canonical, deduped, memberCount duplicated flat and cross-checked on read

work.fanout_checkpoint.id: exactly the fanoutId; completed sorted deduped; cursor null only when enumeration fully admitted

work.fanout_child.id: fanout-child/v1/{enc(parentOccurrence)}/{enc(handler)}/{enc(recordId)}; childId duplicates row id flat and is re-derived on read; cause null until terminal; completed cause has no reason, skipped/failed need closed reasons

work.receipt_association.id: receipt-assoc/v1/{enc(model)}/{enc(recordId)}/{enc(field)}; one row per locator; conditional update refuses decreased revision before the store

work.receipt.id: deliveryId, one row per delivery attempt

outbox_id.rule: obx_{sha256hex('can-work/outbox-id/v1\0{operationId}\0{source}\0{occurrenceIndex}')}; non-empty operationId/source, integer occurrenceIndex >= 0 else RangeError

every_slot.rule: slotStartMs=floor(nowMs/periodMs)*periodMs, slot=slotStartMs/1000; periodMs positive integer multiple of 1000

claim_identity.rule: opaque mints compared by equality only: unclaimed|held-by-caller|held-elsewhere; never ordered

occurrence_ids_general.rule: opaque runtime mints via OccurrenceIdPort.nextOccurrenceId; callers never compare for ordering

result_identity.occurrence_receipt_replay: put-if-absent by occurrenceId; duplicate delivery replays the recorded receipt without re-executing; terminal failures replay; transient throws propagate unrecorded so the same occurrence retries (test: event occurrence admission, green in CMD4)
result_identity.intent_lifecycle_map: pending->staged (skipped when guard pinned false); claimed|uncertain->claimed; delivered->done; failed|dead->failed; terminal = done|failed|skipped (source: packages/work/src/intent/index.ts:360-378)
result_identity.fanout_terminal_replay: completed|skipped|failed rows project their recorded outcome and replay it, minting nothing; pending|running project null (source: packages/work/src/dispatch/index.ts:330-363)
result_identity.commit_gate: staged (commit null) never dispatches; requireCommitted throws 'staged but not committed; dispatch refused' (source: packages/work/src/intent/index.ts:385-392)

state_clone_only_primitive.jsonClone: bare structuredClone; any clone failure becomes StateError('validation', '<what> must be JSON data.') — never a raw DataCloneError (source: packages/state/src/internal/json.ts:16-22)
state_clone_only_primitive.checkJsonSafe: separate JSON.stringify probe; unserializable values (bigint, circular) become StateError('validation', '<what> holds non-JSON values.') (source: packages/state/src/internal/json.ts:29-35)
state_clone_only_primitive.application_order: CLONE FIRST, probe the clone after: staging clones args/payload via jsonClone(checkPlainObject(...)) then checkJsonSafe(cloned) (source: packages/state/src/effects/staging.ts:110-114,173-177)
state_clone_only_primitive.not_frozen: state clones are not frozen (probe: frozen=false)

work_safety_then_clone.kernel_tables: SAFETY FIRST: newRow/withRowData run recursive checkJsonSafe (finite JSON only; undefined/function/symbol/bigint rejected; cycles rejected with path) BEFORE structuredClone, so staged rows never alias caller data (source: packages/work/src/kernel/tables.ts:238-274,398-423,429-450)
work_safety_then_clone.freezeRequest: structuredClone first (uncloneable -> raw DataCloneError, observed), then plain-record shape check (TypeError 'must be a plain JSON record'), then cycle-safe deep freeze in place (source: packages/work/src/intent/index.ts:58-83)
work_safety_then_clone.mirror_note: state receipt tables.ts newRow/withRowData use the same safety-then-clone order as work kernel tables (source: packages/state/src/receipt/tables.ts:323-350)

clone_semantics.vectors: original-fixtures/clone-vectors.json (10 executed cases incl. DataCloneError vs StateError vs TypeError split)

error_trace_ordering.dispatch_attempt: refused-uncommitted -> refused-inherited-scope -> superseded -> refused-state -> unavailable -> skipped(guard-false) -> refused-revoked -> claimed; later checks never run after a refusal (source: packages/work/src/dispatch/index.ts:174-224)
error_trace_ordering.fanout_child_claim: terminal-replay -> running-held -> stale-check -> inherited-scope -> guard-on-current -> revoked -> claim; replay/held bypass the fence as idempotent reads; refusals record terminal failed/inaccessible-record; guard-false records skipped/non-applicable; attempts increment for executed attempts only (source: packages/work/src/dispatch/index.ts:266-299)
error_trace_ordering.staging_join: per effect: guard-shape -> fanout-lineage -> derive id -> duplicate-id -> freeze request -> origin -> stage-time guard verdict (only explicit true stages; false/throws/non-boolean fail closed); whole batch fail-closed (source: packages/work/src/intent/index.ts:295-347)
error_trace_ordering.observe_selected_receipt: locator resolution (throws) -> selected-shape validation (throws) -> trusted store agreement incl. receipt/association revision equality (throws) -> leaf authorization (verdict; grants before presence, first-selected order) -> presence branch -> projection (source: packages/work/src/observation/observation.ts:322-330,338-382)
error_trace_ordering.recovery_scan: claimed+stale->resume; pending+guard-false->skipped; failed+transient+budget->retry, exhausted->dead, terminal|unclassified->terminal; uncertain+not-found->retry, delivered|failed evidence->reconcile, none->awaiting; delivered|dead settled; all lists id-sorted (source: packages/work/src/recovery/index.ts:449-466)
error_trace_ordering.failure_classify_record: transient kind->transient retry class, else terminal; delivered/failed/uncertain outcomes; transient keeps pending under SAME occurrence id until cap|horizon->dead; terminal->failed; uncertain resolves only via reconcileUncertain (source: packages/work/src/receipt/index.ts:54-56,100-137)
error_trace_ordering.kernel_claim_pins: test-pinned: superseded/guard-pinned/held/settled refuse without writes; settled reports before guard-false on terminal rows; missing rows and bad args throw loudly (test: kernel commands dispatch.claim, green in CMD4)

persisted_bytes.method: one row per table built by the real constructors with fixed inputs, committed insert-only (expectedRevision 0 -> 1) through the real createD1Storage and createDOStorage commit paths against recording fakes; the bound data parameter (INSERT INTO records, 12th binding) captured verbatim; adapters serialize with bare JSON.stringify(row.data) (source: packages/state/src/storage/d1.ts:721,744; packages/state/src/storage/durable-object.ts:676,697)

schedule_key_pin.rule: slash-joined percent-encoded app/ownerPackage/owner/key; total length over 128 UTF-16 units throws fail-closed, never truncates (source: packages/work/src/kernel/commands.ts:743-767, unexported embedScheduleKey)
schedule_key_pin.observed: key 'a/b c' + scope {app:'Can X', owner:'t/1', ownerPackage:'my pkg'} -> 'Can%20X/my%20pkg/t%2F1/a%2Fb%20c'; 128 holds, 129 throws /exceeds 128 characters/ in put and cancel (test: kernel commands schedule key embedding, green in CMD4)
